items.title: Sadie Goodson Interview, 1984-12-12
items.q: Florida Beck, she taught me music there in Pensacola.

ctx.x: You know, played for a soft, you know, like that. She never played with no band like I did.

How about Florida Beck? Florida Beck, she taught me music there in Pensacola. Oh she did? But the father, you get so high, I couldn't be bothered by the father. Yeah. If Florida get high, she wouldn't show up. Yeah. I told my mother, I said, you're paying all that money money for me. I said, Florida ain't going to show up.
I was young too, you know, I told her. I said, forget about it, Mom.
